title: boardctl init: fresh users cannot bootstrap a board — create fails on every empty-board state (topology-B misdetect, stale board.db error, schema-mirror refusal)
reasoning: Dogfood 2026-09-04: on a scratch repo, boardctl create fails three ways when the board is empty: (1) no board files at all -> 'no JSONL foreman board found' exit 1 (no init subcommand exists to create tasks.jsonl+events.jsonl+board.jsonl); (2) after hand-making empty tasks.jsonl+events.jsonl -> misdetected as topology B with STALE DuckDB-era error 'header lives in board.db (DuckDB cache) - use scripts/update header manually' (board.db was removed 2026-09-03 and scripts/ does not exist in the repo); (3) after adding a header-only board.jsonl -> 'tasks.jsonl is empty - no row to mirror the schema from; cannot create'. Net: time-to-first-success is blocked entirely for a new project. Fix: add 'boardctl init [-C dir] [--project P --namespace NS]' that writes the three files (topology A) and then lets create work on the empty tasks.jsonl (schema from built-in default row, not mirror-from-last). Also fix the stale topology-B error text to describe real topology B (header on line 1 of tasks.jsonl) and drop the board.db/scripts references.
worker_summary: boardctl init lands (topology-A bootstrap, create-on-empty, topology-B msg fix); judge PASS 4ca4936b

title: Write vocabulary unenforced on guard/ci/priority/depends-on; validate+doctor silent on resulting junk rows

title: README promises events boardctl never writes: create claims '+ task_created event', update claims '+ completion event + header bump' — neither happens
reasoning: Dogfood 2026-09-04: filed BT-005..BT-010 via boardctl create and events.jsonl stayed at 5 rows (only manual 'event' appends + history). Source check: AppendEvent is called ONLY from the event subcommand (cmd/boardctl/main.go:523); create and update paths never call it, and update does not bump the header. README states: 'create a task row (appends tasks.jsonl + task_created event)' and 'update a task row (status flip + completion event + header bump)'. Both are false. Impact: every consumer relying on the events trail for task lifecycle (foremen, audits, sync tooling) silently loses the record; the append-only audit story is the point of events.jsonl. Fix: either write the events (task_created on create; task_completed/status-flip event + header last_commit bump on update --commit-hash) or correct the README and document that the event trail is manual-only. Writing them is the right fix — the audit trail is load-bearing fleet doctrine.
